focus_areas: Hair strand coherence and lack of melting/fusion at the tips.
Boundary sharpness between the wig and the background.
Integration of the wig hairline with the forehead (if visible).

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hairline area. In AI-generated images, wigs often fail to blend naturally with the skin, showing a hard edge or unnatural density drop-off. Also, verify if the curls maintain structural integrity without merging into each other (fusion artifacts). The low resolution may mask some artifacts, so rely on the perceptual quality auditor for texture analysis.
